name: Ron Soyaa
overview: Following two small-town best friends who have just finished their school exams, the story traces their transition into a new phase of life. Their journey takes an unexpected turn when one of them relocates to a prestigious institute in the capital city, thrusting the duo into an unfamiliar world of high-society expectations, comedy, and lighthearted mischief. Amidst chasing after personal goals, navigating local rivalries, and dealing with overprotective families, they must figure out their futures while discovering the true essence of love, youth, and friendship.
